reasoning_paths.description: Armando Luis Juarez participated in the Home Depot shooting; that shooting directly resulted in Officer Crystal Almeida being injured and requiring surgery.
The police chase involving Armando Luis Juarez resulted in his arrest, after which he was taken into custody and transferred to the Dallas County Jail.
The Home Depot shooting caused the death of Officer Rogelio Santander, and Mayor Mike Rawlings publicly announced Santander’s death during a city‑council meeting.
Dallas Police Chief U. Renee Hall is affiliated with the Dallas Police Department, the same department to which Officer Crystal Almeida is affiliated.
